# dsh-ask-first
A clarification button for the DeepSeek Harness composer — it asks what you meant before it rewrites
ation button for the DeepSeek Harness composer — it asks what you meant before it rewrites anything.
中文说明 · Source
Most prompt-rewriting plugins assume you can already say what you want, and only tidy up the wording

.
This one assumes the opposite: the draft is vague because **the person could not say it yet**. So

it
restates what it understood, asks two or three questions that can be answered by clicking, and on

ly
then rewrites — into a request an agent can start on without asking again.
It says what it thinks you meant, asks what would actually change the answer, and hands back a reque

st
with a goal, the constraints, and a definition of done.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Or in the GUI: **Plugins → Add plugin**, and paste `dsh-ask-first`.
The plugin has a browser half, so **restart the host** after installing. The button then sits at the
bottom-left of the composer, on the send row. There is nothing to configure and no key to paste.
## Try it on one vague draft
### 1. Type three words, then click 说清楚点

Put something short in the composer — even "make me a page" — and click **说清楚点** (Say it clearer)
be
fore sending. The button's tooltip reads *不用会描述：点几下选项，我替你把需求问清楚*.

The panel opens with the title **说清楚点** and the line **先问清楚，再发送**. Your draft is untouched,
and noth

th the title **说清楚点** and the line **先问清楚，再发送**. Your draft is untouched,
and nothing has been sent.
### 2. Read the restatement, then answer by clicking

The first block in the panel is one sentence under the label **我理解你想要的是** — the model's own
words fo

r what it took from your draft. That sentence is the only thing that tells you whether it
understood
you, which is why it gets its own block instead of being folded into the result.

Below it: **理解对了吗？下面几问点一下就行，不用打字。** Two or three questions follow, picked because
their answers woul

d change the result. Every question comes with clickable options, and every question
ends with **我不知
道，你替我定** — so a user who cannot answer still has a way to answer.

Typing is optional throughout. Each question also takes a free-text line, labelled
**或者自己写一个答法（可留空）*
*, and the panel says so: **不想答的留空就行；一个都不选也能直接重写。**
### 3. Take the rewrite back into the composer

Click **按这些重写** and you get **正在按你的选择重写……**, then the result under
**觉得可以就直接填回输入框；还能再改。**, with a ch

* and you get **正在按你的选择重写……**, then the result under
**觉得可以就直接填回输入框；还能再改。**, with a character count.
The rewrite is one request an agent can start on: goal first, then the constraints, then what counts

as
done. Anything the model does not actually know stays as a visible `[待补充：…]` placeholder instead

of
being invented. Three buttons: **填回输入框**, **重新问一遍**, **关掉**.
**It never sends.** Writing the draft back is the last thing it does; the send key stays yours.
## What distinguishes it from other prompt rewriters
- **It restates before it asks** — the panel opens with *"what I understand you want is …"* in its o

wn block, so a wrong reading is visible before you spend a rewrite on it.
- **Questions you can answ
er without typing** — options are generated from that specific draft, not pulled from a fixed questi

onnaire, and the last option of every question is **我不知道，你替我定**.
- **The zero-typing path is enforce
d in code** — if the model returns no options, or forgets the escape option, the host half adds them

before the panel renders. It is not left to the prompt.
- **It will not invent parameters** — anyth

ing genuinely unknown stays as `[待补充：…]`, to fill in or delete.
- **It never sends** — the result go

es back into the composer through `inputActions.setDraft()` and stops there.
- **Your current model,

no setup** — no API key, no provider config, no settings page.
- **A bad model reply is not a failu
re** — if the answer is not parseable JSON, the raw text becomes the restatement and the panel goes
straight to rewriting.
## When not to use it
- **You already write clear requests.** Then every click costs you two model calls to learn nothing.
- **You want the agent to just start.** This button's whole job is to ask first — the opposite of "

stop asking me, go".
- **You want different wording for the same request.** Tone, translation and sh

ortening are rewrite jobs; this one changes what the request *is*.
- **No LLM service is wired up in
your host.** The panel says it cannot reach the local rewriter rather than producing a fake result.
## How it works
Two halves, one package.
| Path | Role |
| `lib/index.js` | Host half. Registers three loopback-only `POST` routes and makes every model call

(`ctx.llm.stream`). |
| `lib/client.js` | Browser half. Registers the button and the panel in the `

conversation.input.left` slot, and writes the result back with `inputActions.setDraft()`. |
| `cordi

s.patch.yml` | Lets the host insert this package into the plugin tree. |
| `test-offline.mjs` | Offl
ine self-check. No network, no host: `node test-offline.mjs`. |
### Routes
| Method | Path | Body | Response |

| POST | `/api/dsh-ask-first/health` | `{}` | `{ ok, value: { llm, provider?, model? } }` |
| POST |
`/api/dsh-ask-first/ask` | `{ draft }` | `{ ok, value: { guess, questions: [{ id, question, hint, o

ptions[] }] } }` |
| POST | `/api/dsh-ask-first/rewrite` | `{ draft, answers: [{ question, answer }]
}` | `{ ok, value: { text } }` |

All three accept loopback requests only: the socket address must be `127.0.0.1`, `::1` or
`::ffff:12

7.0.0.1`, the `Host` header must be loopback, and a request whose `Origin` points at another
host —
or which carries `sec-fetch-site: cross-site` — is refused with `403`.
### Which model it uses
No API key, no provider config, no settings page. The plugin calls `ctx.llm.stream` with the provide

r and
model that `agentDefaultModel.currentSelection()` reports — the same one shown in the corner o

f the
composer. If that service is unavailable it omits both and lets the host fall back to the last

r. If that service is unavailable it omits both and lets the host fall back to the last target
used.
